rule_description: The Activity should not be having the launch mode attribute set to "singleTask" (CWE-1021)
message: The Activity should not be having the launch mode attribute set to "singleTask". It is then possible for other applications to place a malicious activity on top of the activity stack resulting in Task Hijacking/StrandHogg 1.0 vulnerability. This makes the application an easy target for phishing attacks. The vulnerability can be remediated by setting the launch mode attribute to "singleInstance" or by setting an empty taskAffinity (taskAffinity="") attribute. You can also update the target SDK version (26) of the app to 28 or higher to fix this issue at platform level.
root_cause: Activities missing explicit targetSdk in manifest or taskAffinity isolation
remediation: Add explicit targetSdkVersion="37" and taskAffinity="" to manifests
resolution_details: Enforced targetSdk 37 across project build.gradle, added android:taskAffinity="" to decouple activities from caller tasks, and marked non-exported activities exported=false.

rule_description: This flag allows anyone to backup your application data via adb (CWE-921)
message: This flag allows anyone to backup your application data via adb. It allows users who have enabled USB debugging to copy application data off of the device.
root_cause: Manifest allows ADB backup or lacks explicit allowBackup="false" declaration
remediation: Explicitly declare android:allowBackup="false" on all application manifests
resolution_details: Added explicit android:allowBackup="false" across all subproject and debug manifests.

remediation: Explicitly declare android:allowBackup="false" on all application manifests
resolution_details: Added explicit android:allowBackup="false" across all subproject and debug manifests.

rule_description: SHA-1 is a weak hash known to have hash collisions (CWE-327)
message: SHA-1 is a weak hash known to have hash collisions.
root_cause: AOSP Dalvik/ART DEX specification requires SHA-1 signature at byte offset 12 in DEX header
remediation: Retain DEX file format compliance and document AOSP Dalvik specification requirement
tests_required: Verify stealth APK generation and DEX loading
resolution_details: AOSP DEX file format header specification strictly mandates 20-byte SHA-1 signature at offset 12. Changing algorithm causes art/dalvik runtime verification failure.

message: Insecure WebView Implementation. Execution of user controlled code in WebView is a critical Security Hole.

rule_description: An Intent received via getParcelableExtra or Intent.parseUri is re-dispatched (CWE-926)
message: An Intent received via getParcelableExtra or Intent.parseUri is re-dispatched. If the component is exported, a malicious app can supply an embedded Intent and escalate privileges (intent redirection).
root_cause: Unvalidated PackageInstaller confirmation intent started via startActivity across exported receiver boundary
remediation: Validate Intent component and package against verified system package installers before startActivity
tests_required: Unit/Integration test with safe and malicious intents

message: PendingIntent is created without FLAG_IMMUTABLE. Prior to API 31, PendingIntents are mutable by default; a malicious app may amend the wrapped Intent (action, data, flags), especially when the base Intent is implicit. Always specify FLAG_IMMUTABLE unless mutability is required.
root_cause: PendingIntent requires FLAG_MUTABLE for PackageInstaller callbacks and Notification RemoteInput per Android framework API design
remediation: Ensure all mutable PendingIntents have explicit package or component targets to prevent interception
tests_required: Verify PackageInstaller callback delivery and notification inline reply
resolution_details: Android OS PackageInstaller callback protocol and Notification RemoteInput API strictly mandate FLAG_MUTABLE so the OS can populate status and user input into the intent.

rule_description: This App uses RSA Crypto without OAEP padding (CWE-780)
message: This App uses RSA Crypto without OAEP padding. The purpose of the padding scheme is to prevent a number of attacks on RSA that only work when the encryption is performed without padding.
root_cause: RSA/ECB/NoPadding is required by the AOSP ADB wire authentication handshake protocol for PKCS#1 v1.5 client signature
remediation: Retain protocol-mandated signature algorithm and document RFC/AOSP specification compatibility
resolution_details: AOSP adbd protocol specification (system/core/adb/transport.cpp) mandates RSA/ECB/NoPadding with raw ASN.1 DigestInfo. Changing to OAEP breaks ADB pairing.
